title: SWE-Mirror: Scaling Issue-Resolving Datasets by Mirroring Issues Across Repositories
authors_zh: Junhao Wang、Daoguang Zan、Shulin Xin、Siyao Liu、Yurong Wu、Kai Shen
paper_type_zh: 软件工程环境与智能体轨迹构造方法
best_for_zh: 研究可执行 SWE 任务生成、OpenHands 轨迹 SFT、测试 verifier 与数据污染审计的读者
one_line: SWE-Mirror constructs 60,671 executable repair tasks by re-instantiating real GitHub issue semantics in 40 reusable repository Gyms, then reports an SFT mixture of 12,456 successful OpenHands trajectories.
SWE-Mirror 将真实 GitHub issue 的语义重建到 40 个可复用仓库 Gym 中，形成 60,671 个可执行修复任务和 12,456 条成功轨迹的 SFT 混合，但官方数据与代码发布入口尚未核实。
why: It separates the costly repository Gym from the issue semantics being mirrored, providing a scalable programmatic feedback surface for software-engineering agent training while exposing clear semantic-fidelity, contamination, release, and replay risks.
inclusion_reason: SWE-Mirror exposes a concrete environment-backed recipe for turning authentic cross-repository issue semantics into executable software-repair tasks and successful agent trajectories, making its data object, test verifier, construction pipeline, and replay risks directly relevant to environment and agent trajectory data.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The 2025 arXiv paper addresses a specific bottleneck in repository-level software-engineering data: a real GitHub issue is easy to find, but rebuilding its exact dependency, build, and test environment is expensive and often unreliable. Existing routes either attach a new Gym to each historical issue or synthesize many artificial defects inside a few working environments. SWE-Mirror instead asks whether the semantic content of an authentic issue can be moved into a different, functionally similar repository whose Gym already works.

The construction unit is not merely an issue description. A mirrored task binds a target repository and base_commit to a generated problem_statement, a bug- or feature-reversion patch (mirror.patch), a hidden validation patch (test.patch), the inverse reference repair (fix.patch), and full-suite execution logs. A downstream trajectory is a separate object: an OpenHands or MOpenHands sequence of actions and observations ending in a submitted patch and a test-derived outcome. This distinction matters because the paper reports 60,671 tasks but trains on a 12,456-trajectory success-only mixture.

This belongs in the Environment & Agent Trajectory Data track because the reusable Gym, executable state transitions, hidden tests, agent tool interface, and terminal predicate jointly define the supervision signal. It does not solve automatic Gym construction, establish that every mirrored issue is semantically faithful, or provide a verified public release sufficient for replay. The L4 content depth here is therefore supported by the full paper and appendix, while reuse remains blocked by missing official artifact URLs and manifests.

这篇 2025 年 arXiv 论文处理的是仓库级软件工程数据中的一个具体瓶颈：真实 GitHub issue 容易找到，但重建其准确依赖、构建与测试环境成本高且经常不稳定。既有路线要么为每个历史 issue 单独搭建 Gym，要么在少量可运行环境内合成大量人工缺陷。SWE-Mirror 转而研究：能否把真实 issue 的语义内容迁移到功能相似、且 Gym 已经可用的另一个仓库中。

构造单元不只是 issue 描述。一个镜像任务将目标仓库与 base_commit 绑定到生成的 problem_statement、引入缺陷或撤销功能的 mirror.patch、隐藏验证补丁 test.patch、反向得到的参考修复 fix.patch，以及完整测试套件的执行日志。下游轨迹是另一类对象：OpenHands 或 MOpenHands 的动作—观察序列，最终产生提交 patch 和由测试给出的 outcome。区分二者很重要，因为论文报告 60,671 个任务，但训练使用的是仅含成功样本的 12,456 条轨迹混合。

该工作属于“环境与智能体轨迹数据”，因为可复用 Gym、可执行状态转换、隐藏测试、智能体工具接口与 terminal predicate 共同定义了监督信号。它没有解决 Gym 自动构建，没有证明每个镜像 issue 都保持语义忠实，也没有提供足以重放的已核实公开发布物。因此，本卡片的 L4 内容深度由论文全文和附录支撑，但训练复用仍受官方 artifact URL 与 manifest 缺失阻断。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
SWE-Mirror breaks the usual one-task-to-one-Gym coupling. It takes an issue and merged pull request from a source repository, abstracts the functionality, current and expected behavior, symptom, and root-cause pattern, then re-instantiates that abstraction in a similar target repository with an existing executable Gym. The target task retains real-world issue semantics while amortizing the environment across many tasks.

The feedback contract is constructed before the fault. A Test Agent writes test.patch so the new tests pass on the current target code. A separate Mirror Agent then edits non-test source code until those tests fail, producing mirror.patch; reversing it yields fix.patch. The verifier checks full-suite test transitions under three states. It can observe patch applicability and test pass/fail/skip transitions, but it cannot directly determine whether the natural-language issue is realistic, whether the repair is unique, or whether passing tests captures the full intended semantics.

Compared with SWE-Smith, which synthesizes defects inside prepared repositories, SWE-Mirror anchors the abstract problem in an authentic issue from another repository. Compared with SWE-rebench, which scales collection by configuring environments for fresh issues, SWE-Mirror reuses a small Gym pool. Its distinctive contribution is cross-repository semantic transfer plus an executable re-animation contract; the main risk is that the transferred task may pass the contract while no longer matching the source problem.

SWE-Mirror 打破常见的“一个任务对应一个 Gym”耦合。它从源仓库取得 issue 与已合并 pull request，抽象其中的功能、当前与预期行为、症状和根因模式，再把该抽象重建到一个功能相近且已有可执行 Gym 的目标仓库。这样，目标任务保留真实 issue 的语义来源，同时让多个任务分摊环境成本。

反馈契约先于故障构造。Test Agent 编写 test.patch，使新增测试在目标仓库当前代码上通过；另一个 Mirror Agent 随后只修改非测试源码，直到这些测试失败，形成 mirror.patch，其反向补丁成为 fix.patch。verifier 在三种状态下检查完整测试套件的状态转换。它能够观察补丁是否可应用以及测试的通过、失败、跳过转换，却不能直接判断自然语言 issue 是否真实、修复是否唯一，或通过测试是否覆盖完整预期语义。

相较于在已准备仓库内合成缺陷的 SWE-Smith，SWE-Mirror 把抽象问题锚定到另一仓库中的真实 issue；相较于通过为新鲜 issue 配置环境来扩大收集规模的 SWE-rebench，它复用一小组 Gym。其关键变化是“跨仓库语义迁移 + 可执行再实例化契约”，主要风险则是迁移任务可能通过契约却不再忠实于源问题。

title: Method
方法
html:
The pipeline has three phases. In task collection, Qwen3-32B reads each target repository README and emits five search keywords. GitHub search retrieves the top 20 repositories ranked by stars and issue counts. Candidate pull requests must have linked issues, be merged and closed, and edit code. An LM prompt then screens for substantive bug fixes or features that are both high-quality and mirrorable into the target repository. GPT-4o-2024-0513 distills repository-specific names, paths, and traces into a portable abstract description.

In task mirroring, GPT-4.1 backs Agentless-style localization and Search/Replace patch generation. The Test Agent localizes source and test files and creates test.patch; it is required to add nontrivial tests that pass on the current target code. The Mirror Agent receives the abstraction and test-derived structural hints, modifies only non-test source code, and produces mirror.patch that breaks those tests. Comments are removed, the patch is reversed into fix.patch, and a final LM prompt uses the original issue, test.patch, fix.patch, and Gym examples to write problem_statement.

Verification first checks that mirror.patch applies to base_commit, and that test.patch and fix.patch apply after it. The full suite is then run as Run.log after the mirror patch, Test.log after adding tests, and Fix.log after all three patches. Accepted transitions preserve existing results, introduce at least one ANY -> FAILED -> PASSED test, forbid listed pass/skip-to-failure regressions, and discard flaky or abnormal cases. Deduplication requires different fail-to-pass tests and different fix.patch content. Seed Gyms come from SWE-Gym, SWE-rebench, and Multi-SWE-RL; Gym selection uses a five-minute full-suite limit, 1 GB memory limit, and a manual basic functional check.

For post-training data, Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Claude 4 Sonnet are used as expert generators on a 15,000-task subset; each task receives three trials at temperature 1.0 and at most 100 rounds. A trajectory is successful only if it issues finish and its final patch passes a superset of the tests repaired by fix.patch. The process yields 6,431 successful SWE-Mirror episodes, combined with 6,025 SWE-rebench episodes. Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct-7B and 32B are fine-tuned for at most three epochs with AdamW, weight decay 0.01, warmup ratio 0.1, peak learning rate 5e-5, and 32,768-token context. Error Masking keeps erroneous actions in context but removes their response loss; it does not retain wholly failed episodes as positive demonstrations.

Exact task splits, the 15,000-task membership list, container images, repository commit manifest, dependency locks, harness/parser revisions, prompt code, random seeds, and model endpoint versions are not available through a verified public artifact. These must be fixed before exact construction or trajectory replay.

流程分为三个阶段。任务收集阶段，Qwen3-32B 阅读每个目标仓库的 README 并生成五个搜索关键词；GitHub 搜索按 star 与 issue 数量取前 20 个仓库。候选 pull request 必须关联 issue、已合并且关闭，并修改代码。随后，LM prompt 筛选实质性的 bug fix 或 feature，要求它既高质量又能镜像到目标仓库。GPT-4o-2024-0513 再把仓库特定名称、路径和 trace 压缩为可迁移的抽象描述。

任务镜像阶段由 GPT-4.1 支撑 Agentless 风格的定位和 Search/Replace patch 生成。Test Agent 定位源码与测试文件并创建 test.patch，要求加入在目标仓库当前代码上能够通过的非平凡测试。Mirror Agent 接收抽象描述和由测试提供的结构线索，只修改非测试源码，生成会使测试失败的 mirror.patch。流程移除其中的注释，把它反转为 fix.patch，最后由 LM 使用原始 issue、test.patch、fix.patch 和 Gym 示例生成 problem_statement。

验证先检查 mirror.patch 能否应用到 base_commit，以及 test.patch 与 fix.patch 能否在其后应用。随后分别在仅应用 mirror patch、再加入测试、以及应用全部三个 patch 的状态下运行完整测试套件，形成 Run.log、Test.log 与 Fix.log。可接受的转换必须保持已有结果、至少包含一个 ANY -> FAILED -> PASSED 测试、禁止论文列出的“通过/跳过变失败”回归，并剔除 flaky 或异常情况。去重要求 fail-to-pass 测试和 fix.patch 内容均不同。种子 Gym 来自 SWE-Gym、SWE-rebench 与 Multi-SWE-RL；Gym 选择设置完整测试五分钟、内存 1 GB 的限制，并进行人工基础功能检查。

后训练数据方面，Claude 3.7 Sonnet 与 Claude 4 Sonnet 被用作 15,000 个任务子集上的专家生成器；每个任务进行三次采样，温度为 1.0，每次最多 100 轮。只有发出 finish，且最终 patch 通过的测试集合覆盖 fix.patch 所修复测试的轨迹才算成功。流程得到 6,431 条成功 SWE-Mirror episode，再与 6,025 条 SWE-rebench episode 合并。Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct-7B 与 32B 最多微调三个 epoch，使用 AdamW、0.01 weight decay、0.1 warmup ratio、峰值学习率 5e-5 和 32,768 token 上下文。Error Masking 保留错误动作的上下文，但屏蔽对应 response loss；它并不把整体失败 episode 当作正向示范保留。

准确任务 split、15,000 个任务的成员列表、容器镜像、仓库 commit manifest、依赖锁、harness/parser 修订、prompt 代码、随机种子和模型 endpoint 版本，均无法从已核实公开 artifact 中取得。精确重建任务或重放轨迹前必须固定这些要素。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Construction evidence is reported at three levels. On a balanced manually selected set of 100 issues, the LM high-quality/mirrorability filter has 84.3% precision and 86.0% recall (Table 2). On 100 manually selected candidates for each of four languages, end-to-end mirroring succeeds on 46.0% overall: Python 68.0%, JavaScript 52.0%, Go 36.0%, and Rust 28.0%. Compile or syntax errors account for 2.0%, 6.0%, 28.0%, and 36.0% respectively, showing that the pipeline's yield is not language-neutral (Table 3).

Three annotators audit the 184 successfully generated tasks from that study against their source issue and pull request. Of 177 tasks with a majority label, 115 are rated high consistency and 41 moderate consistency, totaling 156/177 or 88.1%; 21 are inconsistent and 7 have no majority. This is useful direct evidence about semantic transfer, but it is a selected 184-task audit rather than an estimate over all 60,671 retained instances (Table 4).

The final task counts are 46,820 Python instances from 31 repositories, 7,183 Rust from 6, 4,056 Go from 2, and 2,612 JavaScript from 1, totaling 60,671 tasks across 40 repositories (Table 5). Table 1 reports about 100 GB of environment storage. These numbers support environment amortization; they do not establish that every generated problem is realistic, independent, legally reusable, or uncontaminated.

For the reported 12,456-episode SFT mixture, SWE-Mirror-LM-7B reaches 22.8% on SWE-bench Verified versus 1.0% for the Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct-7B base, while the 32B model reaches 52.2% versus 6.2%. On Multi-SWE-Bench-Flash the two models score 6.33% and 21.33% (Table 6). Main evaluation uses temperature 0, 131,072-token context with YaRN, and at most 100 interaction rounds. These are author-reported resolve rates under the OpenHands/MOpenHands scaffold, not independent replication.

Ablations at 4,096 SWE-Mirror trajectories show the 32B Error Masking model at 35.6%, compared with 33.6% for Response Only and 29.2% for Error Pruning; the untrained baseline is 6.2% (Figure 2). With 512 non-Python trajectories, the 7B model scores 10.2% after Go training, 11.3% after Rust, and 9.4% after JavaScript on Python-only SWE-bench Verified, versus 1.0% for the base (Table 7). These comparisons support the paper's training-utility claim within the specified budgets, but they do not isolate mirroring quality from teacher, scaffold, context, or mixed-source trajectory effects.

构造证据分为三层。对人工平衡选择的 100 个 issue，LM 的高质量/可镜像筛选器达到 84.3% precision 与 86.0% recall（表 2）。对四种语言各人工选择 100 个候选，端到端镜像总体成功率为 46.0%：Python 68.0%、JavaScript 52.0%、Go 36.0%、Rust 28.0%。其中 compile 或 syntax error 分别占 2.0%、6.0%、28.0% 和 36.0%，说明流程产出率并非语言中立（表 3）。

三名标注者将上述研究中成功生成的 184 个任务与其源 issue 和 pull request 对照审计。177 个取得多数标签的任务中，115 个为高一致性、41 个为中等一致性，合计 156/177，即 88.1%；另有 21 个不一致、7 个没有多数结论。这是语义迁移的直接证据，但它是对 184 个选定任务的审计，不能直接代表全部 60,671 个保留实例（表 4）。

最终任务包括：31 个仓库的 46,820 个 Python 实例、6 个仓库的 7,183 个 Rust 实例、2 个仓库的 4,056 个 Go 实例，以及 1 个仓库的 2,612 个 JavaScript 实例，共计 40 个仓库、60,671 个任务（表 5）。表 1 报告环境存储约 100 GB。这些数字支持“分摊环境成本”的判断，但不能证明每个生成问题都真实、独立、可合法复用或没有污染。

在报告的 12,456 条 episode SFT 混合上，SWE-Mirror-LM-7B 在 SWE-bench Verified 达到 22.8%，对应 Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct-7B base 为 1.0%；32B 模型达到 52.2%，base 为 6.2%。在 Multi-SWE-Bench-Flash 上，两者分别为 6.33% 与 21.33%（表 6）。主评测使用温度 0、经 YaRN 扩展的 131,072 token 上下文和最多 100 轮交互。这些是 OpenHands/MOpenHands scaffold 下的作者报告 resolve rate，并非独立复现。

在 4,096 条 SWE-Mirror 轨迹的消融中，32B Error Masking 为 35.6%，Response Only 为 33.6%，Error Pruning 为 29.2%，未训练 base 为 6.2%（图 2）。使用 512 条非 Python 轨迹时，7B 模型在仅含 Python 的 SWE-bench Verified 上分别达到 Go 训练 10.2%、Rust 训练 11.3%、JavaScript 训练 9.4%，base 为 1.0%（表 7）。这些比较在给定预算内支持训练效用主张，但没有把镜像质量与 teacher、scaffold、上下文或混合来源轨迹的影响完全分离。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest construction baselines expose two different scaling levers. SWE-rebench collects fresh historical tasks and invests in configuring their environments; SWE-Smith reuses prepared environments but generates synthetic defects from the target repository itself. SWE-Mirror combines the two ideas by taking the semantic pattern from an authentic external issue while placing the executable task inside a reusable target Gym.

The new data interface is the paired transfer object: source issue/PR abstraction, target problem_statement, generated hidden test.patch, fault-inducing mirror.patch, inverse fix.patch, and three-state test logs. The feedback interface also contributes a stricter transition contract than a single final test run: tests must behave coherently before the added validation, fail after the issue is introduced, and recover without listed regressions after the inverse fix.

Many components are inherited rather than novel: GitHub issue mining, Agentless-style localization and patch generation, SWE-style task schemas, executable tests, OpenHands/MOpenHands interaction, rejection of unsuccessful trajectories, and Qwen2.5-Coder SFT all have prior precedents. The scale of 60,671 tasks and reuse of 40 Gyms is an engineering expansion, while cross-repository semantic re-instantiation is the conceptual change. Before treating that change as a reusable recipe, curators must inspect source-to-target fidelity, duplicate semantics, hidden-test adequacy, environment pinning, release completeness, and benchmark overlap.

最接近的构造基线提供两种不同的扩展杠杆：SWE-rebench 收集新鲜历史任务，并投入成本配置其环境；SWE-Smith 复用已准备环境，但在目标仓库内部生成合成缺陷。SWE-Mirror 组合两者：从外部真实 issue 获取语义模式，同时把可执行任务放入可复用的目标 Gym。

新的数据接口是成对迁移对象：源 issue/PR 抽象、目标 problem_statement、生成的隐藏 test.patch、引入故障的 mirror.patch、反向 fix.patch，以及三种状态的测试日志。反馈接口也比单次最终测试更严格：新增验证之前测试行为必须一致，issue 引入后必须失败，应用反向修复后必须恢复且不能出现论文列出的回归。

不少组件来自既有工作，而非本文独创，包括 GitHub issue 挖掘、Agentless 风格的定位与 patch 生成、SWE 风格任务 schema、可执行测试、OpenHands/MOpenHands 交互、拒绝失败轨迹和 Qwen2.5-Coder SFT。60,671 个任务与 40 个 Gym 的复用属于工程规模扩展，跨仓库语义再实例化才是概念变化。把它作为可复用 recipe 前，仍需检查源到目标的忠实度、语义重复、隐藏测试充分性、环境固定、发布完整性与 benchmark overlap。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Programmatic validity is narrower than semantic correctness. The three-state test contract can reject non-applicable patches, missing fail-to-pass behavior, regressions, and some flaky outcomes, but weak generated tests can still admit underspecified or trivial tasks. The human audit exposes this boundary: 21 of 177 majority-labeled tasks are inconsistent with the source issue and 7 more lack a majority classification. Because fix.patch is the inverse of mirror.patch, the reference solution may encode the generator's chosen edit rather than the full space of valid repairs.

The selection pipeline can produce both false positives and false negatives. Its 84.3% precision and 86.0% recall are measured on a balanced 100-issue sample, not the natural candidate distribution. Mirroring yield falls to 28.0% for Rust and 36.0% for Go, and compile/syntax failures are much more common there than in Python. These differences can bias the final language mixture toward problems and repositories that are easy for the agents and harness to manipulate.

Trajectory reporting is success-only. The 6,431 SWE-Mirror episodes and 6,025 SWE-rebench episodes are retained after terminal success; counts and artifacts for wholly failed, timed-out, flaky, or infrastructure-error rollouts are not disclosed. Error Masking retains an erroneous turn only inside an ultimately successful episode and masks that response's loss. It should not be described as failure-data training or as evidence that unsuccessful episodes were preserved.

No verified task/trajectory split, immutable instance manifest, or overlap audit is available. The paper evaluates on SWE-bench Verified and Multi-SWE-Bench-Flash but does not document task-level checks against those benchmarks, the source repositories and issues, reference patches, or teacher pretraining. This creates contamination and evaluation-to-training leakage risk. It also prevents checking whether repeated source issue patterns appear in multiple target repositories.

Exact replay remains blocked. The paper does not provide a verified public artifact containing target repository commits, container image digests, dependency locks, test parser and harness revisions, per-instance logs, prompts, seeds, teacher endpoint versions, or task-to-trajectory mappings. The arXiv manuscript is CC BY 4.0, but that license does not establish redistribution rights for source repository code, issue and PR prose, patches, tests, dependencies, generated tasks, or proprietary-teacher trajectories. Curator inference: no personal user data is central to the method, yet GitHub issue/PR text can contain names, emails, secrets, or security-sensitive details, so privacy and secret scanning are still necessary before release.

程序化有效性窄于语义正确性。三状态测试契约能够拒绝不可应用 patch、缺少 fail-to-pass 行为、回归以及部分 flaky outcome，但薄弱的生成测试仍可能放过定义不足或过于简单的任务。人工审计清楚暴露了这条边界：177 个取得多数标签的任务中有 21 个与源 issue 不一致，另有 7 个没有多数分类。由于 fix.patch 是 mirror.patch 的反向补丁，参考解可能只编码生成器选定的修改，而不是完整的有效修复空间。

筛选流程同时可能产生 false positive 与 false negative。84.3% precision 和 86.0% recall 来自人工平衡的 100 个 issue 样本，而不是自然候选分布。Rust 镜像成功率降至 28.0%，Go 为 36.0%，且 compile/syntax failure 明显多于 Python。这些差异可能使最终语言混合偏向更容易被 agent 与 harness 操作的问题和仓库。

轨迹报告只保留成功样本。6,431 条 SWE-Mirror episode 与 6,025 条 SWE-rebench episode 都经过终局成功筛选；整体失败、超时、flaky 或基础设施错误 rollout 的数量与 artifact 未披露。Error Masking 只在最终成功 episode 内保留错误 turn 的上下文，并屏蔽该 response 的 loss。不能把它描述为失败数据训练，也不能据此声称未成功 episode 得到保留。

当前没有已核实的任务/轨迹 split、不可变 instance manifest 或 overlap audit。论文在 SWE-bench Verified 与 Multi-SWE-Bench-Flash 上评测，却没有记录任务级别的 benchmark、源仓库与 issue、参考 patch 或 teacher pretraining 对照检查。这带来污染和评测数据进入训练的风险，也无法检查同一源 issue 模式是否在多个目标仓库重复出现。

精确重放仍被阻断。论文没有提供已核实公开 artifact 来固定目标仓库 commit、容器镜像 digest、依赖锁、测试 parser 与 harness 修订、逐实例日志、prompt、seed、teacher endpoint 版本或任务到轨迹映射。arXiv 论文采用 CC BY 4.0，但该许可不能证明源仓库代码、issue/PR 文本、patch、测试、依赖、生成任务或闭源 teacher 轨迹的再分发权利。curator inference：方法并不以个人用户数据为核心，但 GitHub issue/PR 文本可能包含姓名、邮箱、secret 或安全敏感细节，因此发布前仍需隐私与 secret scan。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For data construction research, SWE-Mirror is a concrete recipe for multiplying tasks per configured repository: abstract a real issue, generate target-native tests before introducing the fault, construct a reversible source patch, and verify three execution states. A reproduction study can compare this recipe with within-repository mutation and fresh-environment collection while holding the target Gym and agent scaffold fixed.

For agent training, the task object can support executable rejection sampling, and successful OpenHands/MOpenHands episodes can support SFT of state-action behavior. Error Masking offers a specific ablation for learning recovery context without applying loss to malformed or invalid actions. Researchers should independently vary task count, unique source issues, target-repository count, successful trajectories, and inference budget instead of treating all of them as a single data-scale variable.

For evaluation and audit, the three logs and explicit patches define useful checks: replay Run.log, Test.log, and Fix.log; compare source and target issue semantics; test whether alternative repairs pass hidden tests; measure task duplication across mirrors; and inspect whether an agent edits tests, exploits the harness, or leaks test.patch or fix.patch. The human-fidelity labels and language-specific yield rates also motivate stratified audits rather than one aggregate pass rate.

Current reuse class: reading and audit reference only. Training or evaluation reuse is blocked pending a verified official dataset/code release, immutable version, environment manifest, split and decontamination report, component-license review, secret/privacy scan, failed-outcome ledger, and successful end-to-end replay on sampled instances. The paper's reported benchmark results are not a substitute for those checks.

对数据构造研究而言，SWE-Mirror 给出了扩大单个已配置仓库任务数的具体 recipe：抽象真实 issue，在引入故障前先生成目标仓库原生测试，构造可逆源码 patch，再验证三种执行状态。复现研究可以固定目标 Gym 与 agent scaffold，对比跨仓库镜像、仓库内 mutation 和新鲜环境收集三种路线。

对智能体训练而言，任务对象可支持可执行 rejection sampling，成功 OpenHands/MOpenHands episode 可用于 state-action 行为的 SFT。Error Masking 提供了一个明确消融：保留恢复上下文，但不对格式错误或无效动作计算 loss。研究者应分别改变任务数量、唯一源 issue 数、目标仓库数、成功轨迹数和推理预算，而不是把它们合并为一个“数据规模”变量。

对评测与审计而言，三份日志和显式 patch 定义了可操作检查：重放 Run.log、Test.log 与 Fix.log；比较源与目标 issue 语义；测试替代修复能否通过隐藏测试；测量不同镜像之间的任务重复；检查 agent 是否修改测试、利用 harness，或泄露 test.patch/fix.patch。人工忠实度标签和按语言分列的成功率也支持分层审计，而不是只看汇总通过率。

当前复用等级为“仅适合作为阅读与审计参考”。训练或评测复用需等待已核实官方数据/代码发布、不可变版本、环境 manifest、split 与去污染报告、组件许可审查、secret/隐私扫描、失败 outcome 台账，以及抽样实例端到端成功重放。论文报告的 benchmark 结果不能替代这些检查。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the objects separate: 60,671 mirrored tasks, 6,431 successful SWE-Mirror episodes, 6,025 successful SWE-rebench episodes, and a 12,456-episode SFT mixture.
  • Read Sections 2.2–2.3 and Figure 1 for the test.patch -> mirror.patch -> fix.patch construction and the Run.log -> Test.log -> Fix.log verifier.
  • Table 4 is the key semantic audit: 156/177 majority-labeled tasks are high or moderate consistency, while 21 are inconsistent and 7 of 184 have no majority.
  • Error Masking keeps erroneous turns inside successful episodes but masks their response loss; it is not evidence that fully failed rollouts were released or trained on.
  • Read with SWE-Smith and SWE-rebench, then verify release URLs, commits/images, splits, overlap, licenses, privacy/secret scans, and replay before reuse.

• 必须区分四个对象：60,671 个镜像任务、6,431 条成功 SWE-Mirror episode、6,025 条成功 SWE-rebench episode，以及 12,456 条 episode 的 SFT 混合。
  • 优先阅读第 2.2–2.3 节与图 1，理解 test.patch -> mirror.patch -> fix.patch 构造和 Run.log -> Test.log -> Fix.log verifier。
  • 表 4 是关键语义审计：177 个取得多数标签的任务中，156 个为高或中等一致性，21 个不一致；184 个任务中另有 7 个没有多数结论。
  • Error Masking 保留成功 episode 内的错误 turn，但屏蔽其 response loss；这不能证明整体失败 rollout 已发布或进入训练。
  • 建议与 SWE-Smith、SWE-rebench 对读；复用前还需核实发布 URL、commit/镜像、split、overlap、许可、隐私/secret scan 与重放。
